instructions: Rebuild from the approved wide gantry composition using one broad central loading bay with no intermediate front posts, two enlarged fixed appliance panels at the outer sides, and a simple centered rope block and plain hook visibly carried by the front crossbeam. Make the open unloading path and paired blue/cream panels read before roof detail at the 64-inch gameplay camera. Use a single shallow asymmetric roof supported from the outer timber posts, large readable storage forms outside the center route, and no gear-like, brass-banded, or cylindrical focal hardware. Fit the 24 x 13 x 20 inch envelope; presentation only.
material_method: Component-modeled salvaged timber, two enlarged fixed blue and cream appliance panels, broad mismatched sheet roof and plain iron rope hoist, with baked PBR patina; no Clockwork-coded center hardware.
post_processing: Validate the GLB in Godot against the exact 24 x 13 x 20 inch envelope and verify PBR bindings.
Render close, 64-inch settlement, and 330-inch room views through the review-only Scavenger presentation registry.
Have Luna inspect actual Godot pixels against the approved concept and the current gameplay capture; retain the production registry until the candidate passes its gates.
